description: This file contains functions for querying and managing subagent run records, including filtering, counting, and traversing descendant runs within a session management system.

methods.name: resolveControllerSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves the controller session key from a SubagentRunRecord, trimming whitespace and falling back to requesterSessionKey if necessary.

methods.name: findRunIdsByChildSessionKeyFromRuns
methods.description: Finds all run IDs associated with a specific child session key within a set of runs.

methods.name: listRunsForRequesterFromRuns
methods.description: Lists all runs matching a specific requester session key, optionally filtered by a specific run ID.

methods.name: listRunsForControllerFromRuns
methods.description: Lists all runs associated with a specific controller session key.

methods.name: findLatestRunForChildSession
methods.description: Finds the most recent run for a given child session key.

methods.name: resolveRequesterForChildSessionFromRuns
methods.description: Resolves the requester session key and origin for a given child session key based on the latest run.

methods.name: shouldIgnorePostCompletionAnnounceForSessionFromRuns
methods.description: Determines if a post-completion announce should be ignored for a specific child session based on the latest run's spawn mode and cleanup status.

methods.name: countActiveRunsForSessionFromRuns
methods.description: Counts the number of active runs for a given controller session key, including pending descendant runs.

methods.name: forEachDescendantRun
methods.description: Traverses descendant runs starting from a root session key, applying a visitor function to each run.

methods.name: countActiveDescendantRunsFromRuns
methods.description: Counts active descendant runs from a root session key.

methods.name: countPendingDescendantRunsInternal
methods.description: Internal function to count pending descendant runs, optionally excluding a specific run ID.

methods.name: countPendingDescendantRunsFromRuns
methods.description: Counts pending descendant runs from a root session key.

methods.name: countPendingDescendantRunsExcludingRunFromRuns
methods.description: Counts pending descendant runs excluding a specific run ID.

methods.name: listDescendantRunsForRequesterFromRuns
methods.description: Lists all descendant runs for a requester starting from a root session key.
